summary: Use the wiki as a projection over authoritative artifacts with explicit gaps and feedback from real navigation behavior.

items.text: Generate component, dependency, ownership and deployment facts; reserve manually curated prose for intent, tradeoffs and incident learning.
Open or block a review when code, schema or ownership changes invalidate linked maps and decision records.
Measure failed searches, dead-end pages, time-to-answer and correction frequency to decide which cognitive views deserve maintenance.
